facts.fact: INTIC's 2022 activity report, dated December 2022, gives the Plano Estratégico e Plano Operacional da Sociedade de Informação as covering 2019-2023, in the title of its section 2.4 on evaluating the degree of implementation.
facts.system: Plano Estratégico para a Sociedade de Informação 2019-2028

facts.fact: After INTIC's visit to Brazilian counterparts, the parties agreed to cooperate on drawing up the digital transformation strategy of Mozambique, and the Brazilian SEME agreed to support its construction; the report, dated December 2022, gives no date for the visit and no text.

The same cooperation agreed with Brazilian institutions includes drawing up the Agenda Digital de Moçambique and a digital government strategy; the report, dated December 2022, states no date and no text.
